name: Intel Penang advanced packaging facility
summary: A $7 billion advanced packaging project in Penang, Malaysia, which Intel called its largest facility for 3D packaging technology, announced in late 2021 with a 710,000 square foot cleanroom on two levels. The first cleanroom equipment began arriving in November 2023 and Intel then aimed for operational readiness in 2024. In September 2024 Intel said it would finish construction but time the start-up to market conditions; its 2025 annual report still describes the facility as being built and lists Malaysia among delayed projects. Trade press in September 2026, reporting on Intel's Malaysian operations, said the facility was scheduled to begin operations that year.

milestones.note: Operational readiness targeted for later in 2024; start-up later tied to market conditions.
Trade press reported in September 2026 that operations were scheduled to begin that year.
